review.readiness_note: The visual foundation and product story pass. Close the localized inspection and state-caption gaps before final sign-off, and remove the remaining inclusion-row rules. The still capture supports functional exposure, not proof that navigation, dialogs, sticky handoffs or reduced-motion behavior execute correctly; those need a short interaction smoke test.

review.why: This is a faithful transfer of Frame Shift's language, not a reproduction of the Lab composition. The three-line hero identifies the earning modes quickly; the actual app frames then explain reference, submission, review, booking and earnings. Graphite means making, the supplied Story remains an intact sheet, and Drive separates the unadvertised vehicle illustration from campaign artwork and monthly terms. The native commitment planes restore the source-to-money relationship without floating financial cards. Typography, restrained branding, surfaces and control treatment are substantially consistent. Production states and configured prices remain visible rather than being replaced with cleaner fixtures. The remaining problems are localized: incomplete inspection/provenance coverage, one ambiguous state caption, and residual inclusion-row borders. Nothing visible indicates that core production functionality was removed, although a screenshot cannot establish that actions execute.
review.verdict: Frame Shift has transferred faithfully and TapMart reads as a real working platform; hold final release sign-off for the remaining inspection and literal-state caption fixes, not a redesign.
